claim_verdicts.evidence: Read from the tag object this session: annotated tag stage-0 (664d38a0) -> commit ff911b0. The tree holds scripts/http/status-codes.sh; its body runs `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}  $path\n" "http://localhost:8080$path"` over seven paths. The captured run outputs/stage-0/scripts/http/status-codes.txt begins "200  /index.html", "302  /redirect", "404  /api/v1/orders/999", "401  /admin", "409  /conflict", "503  /slow" — it prints responses. STAGE.md: "CI runs every script and fails if any captured output differs."

STAGE.md at the repository root at the tag, Caddy bullet: "HTTPS is on `https://donhang.local:8443` with a certificate Caddy signs itself". Caddyfile confirms the listener: "donhang.local:8443 { tls internal / root * /srv/www / file_server }". Name, port and scheme are all in the one STAGE.md sentence that section 2 points at.

Same STAGE.md bullet, second half: "add `127.0.0.1 donhang.local` to your hosts file to open it in a browser." The line is quoted in the lesson exactly. The file is named only by kind ("your hosts file"), which is what section 5 says ("a file it names on your own machine"). scripts/up.sh prints the same instruction: "site (TLS)  https://donhang.local:8443/   (add '127.0.0.1 donhang.local' to your hosts file)".

STAGE.md: "`scripts/up.sh` starts the lab"; "A **lab box** (`lab`), a small Linux machine ... Every script under `scripts/` runs there". status-codes.sh line 5 is the redirect line `[ -f /.dockerenv ] || exec "$(dirname "$0")/../lab-run.sh" "$0" "$@"`. docker-compose.yml, service lab: `extra_hosts: - "donhang.local:127.0.0.1"`; Compose spec: "`extra_hosts` adds hostname mappings to the container network interface configuration (`/etc/hosts` for Linux)". outputs/stage-0/scripts/network/resolve.txt prints `127.0.0.1\tdonhang.local` from inside the box.

Blob read from the tag, not the worktree. docs/craft/question-template.md lines 6-11: `Mục tiêu:`, `Đã thử:`, `Mong đợi:`, `Thực tế:`, `Môi trường:`, `Tiếp theo:` — six lines, that order. Byte comparison of the lesson's first code block against source lines 6-11 returned equal (no whitespace normalisation needed).

Line 7: "Đã thử: <những gì tôi đã thử và kết quả từng cái>" — what I tried and the result of each one. Line 9: "Thực tế: <điều đã xảy ra, kèm thông báo lỗi nguyên văn>" — what happened, with the error message verbatim. Both readings are what section 5 asserts.

Lines 34-35 under "## Vì sao mẫu này hoạt động": "Viết xong bốn dòng đầu, rất nhiều lần bạn tự trả lời được câu hỏi — vì viết buộc bạn phải thu hẹp phạm vi, đúng bước bạn đã bỏ qua." The lesson's second code block reproduces lines 34-38 byte for byte (checked programmatically).

Lines 37-38: "Dòng cuối biến câu hỏi thành một quyết định: người đọc biết bạn không đứng yên chờ, và biết khi nào cần chặn bạn lại." Section 5's gloss ("they learn you are moving, and they learn when to stop you") matches both halves.

Lines 42-44, "## Hỏi khi nào": "Đội thường thống nhất một khoảng thời gian, ví dụ 45 phút. Tự tìm trong khoảng đó; hết khoảng đó thì hỏi. Hỏi quá sớm làm phiền người khác; hỏi quá muộn làm mất cả ngày của chính bạn." "thường" carries the same hedge as section 4's "usually", and both costs land on the sides the claim names. Caveat: the only source is the example repository's own prose; no docs root in versions.yaml governs team practice, so the generalisation rests on that file alone.

Tautological: a reader can only judge the route against a goal that is on the page. Section 4 attaches no frequency or measurement ("The goal lets a reader say the whole route is wrong before helping you along it"), so no source decides it.
Definitional: an attempt recorded with its result is, by construction, a possibility the reader no longer has to test. Section 4 asserts nothing measurable about how often readers repeat a search.

Definitional. Calling a result wrong presupposes a standard to judge it against, and the expectation is that standard; section 4 says exactly that and no more ("the result alone says what happened, only the expectation says it was wrong").

Follows from the message described in section 2, which carries no goal, attempts, expectation, error text or environment; any reply must therefore ask for one of them. The consequence is hedged ("can sit unanswered"), not a frequency.

No permitted source settles it. No docs root in content/versions.yaml governs images or screenshots; Grep over refs/ (dotnet-docs, aspnetcore-docs, docker-docs, flutter-website, kubernetes-website, rfc) returns nothing on text inside a picture. Against the claim as written: current desktop OS features lift text out of an image, so "cannot be selected or pasted into a command" is absolute where only "the reader has to retype it or run it through text recognition" is safe. The second half (a picture omits goal, attempts, environment) needs no source.
claim_verdicts.source: content/versions.yaml (no applicable docs root); refs/ (no match)

claim_verdicts.evidence: foundation.l2.debugging-method §3 defines narrowing as "shrinking the distance between the start of the run and the first value that is wrong, by halving the input or the path through the code" and notes as "the running record of what you ran, what you expected and what you got". question-template.md:34-35 gives the same mechanism for writing ("buộc bạn phải thu hẹp phạm vi, đúng bước bạn đã bỏ qua"). Section 4 marks the difference itself ("on paper instead of on a running command").

Definitional in the first half (attempts with results are eliminated possibilities the reader can see) and tautological in the second ("a message with no attempts in it gives them nothing to see"). Section 6 makes no assertion about how colleagues rate the asker, so no source is required.

docs/craft/question-template.md:43-44: "Hỏi quá sớm làm phiền người khác; hỏi quá muộn làm mất cả ngày của chính bạn." — waiting past the agreed span costs your own day, which is what section 6 says. The second half of the claim is hedged ("may be one the person beside you has already met") and asserts nothing measurable.

Half supported, half not. Loopback: refs/docker-docs/.../engine/network/_index.md treats `127.0.0.1` as the machine's own loopback address. Precedence: no page under any docs root in versions.yaml states a name-lookup order for the reader's Windows/macOS/Linux machine; the nearest permitted text, kubernetes-website customize-hosts-file-for-pods.md, is about a Pod. The curriculum's own approved wording is narrower — foundation.l1.dns §3: "which the machine's ordinary name lookup reads before any resolver is asked; some tools, `nslookup` among them, skip it". Section 5 drops that qualifier.
claim_verdicts.suggested_text: "Your machine's ordinary name lookup reads that file before it asks any resolver, so with no line in it nothing on your machine gives the name an address." (Same wording as foundation.l1.dns §3, which is where the reader met the rule.)

issues.text: The prose overstates what the quoted line asks for. The block at docs/craft/question-template.md:10 reads `Môi trường: <phiên bản, môi trường, dữ liệu>` — version, environment, data. It does not ask for the machine or the browser, and the file's filled example under "Ví dụ điền đầy đủ" lists "môi trường thử nghiệm, nhánh `feature/cancel-order`, dữ liệu mẫu của lab" — still no machine. Nothing in the ledger (claims 1-18) covers this sentence, and quiz q6's key rests on it.
issues.quote: `Môi trường` is the line that would have ended the search on its own: it makes you write down your own machine and your own browser.
issues.fix: State what the line asks and then apply it: "`Môi trường` asks for the version, the environment and the data your attempts ran in; in this situation that environment is your own machine and your own browser, which is why this line is the one that would have ended the search on its own." Then register it in `claims` as a new entry, kind `fact`, source_hint docs/craft/question-template.md:10, section 5. Fix section 3's bullet the same way — "environment — the version, the machine, the branch and the data your attempts ran against" adds "the machine" to a form that never asks for it.

issues.text: Unlisted claim: a frequency statement about what the sixth line produces. Nothing in the lesson, nothing in docs/craft/question-template.md and no entry in the ledger (claims 1-18) supports "often" here; the file says nothing at all about what `Môi trường` surfaces. The same paragraph already lost one such twin in an earlier round ("`Đã thử` is usually the longest of the six lines"), so the pattern is unregistered frequency language in Expected result.

issues.text: Claim 18's precedence half is stated without the condition the curriculum itself attached. foundation.l1.dns §3, which the reader has already had, says the hosts file is read "before any resolver is asked" by "the machine's ordinary name lookup", and warns that some tools skip it. This lesson generalises to every lookup on every machine, which no document under a versions.yaml docs root supports.

issues.fix: Use the wording already approved in foundation.l1.dns: "Your machine's ordinary name lookup reads that file before it asks any resolver, so with no line in it nothing on your machine gives the name an address." Update claim 18's text to match.
